package.name: Finco1 Generic Solar / Wind Exploratory Boundary & Demo Guardrail Refresh

allowed_demo_statements.statement: Generic Solar and Generic Wind templates are available.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: Generic Solar and Generic Wind are exploratory. Generic assumptions are illustrative until validated by reference models.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The Generic Defaults Prefill button seeds the canonical reference project defaults into a new Generic project.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: The prefill button is internal functionality. The defaults are illustrative until validated by reference models.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The scenario run loop supports edit → save → run for Generic scenarios.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: The scenario run loop is internal functionality. It is not model validation.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The scenario compare supports 3-way and 4-way Generic scenario comparison.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: The scenario compare is internal functionality. It does not validate the model.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The Multi-Compare Picker is the entry point for the multi-compare flow.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: The Multi-Compare Picker is UI / navigation only. It does not validate the model.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The Generic Export / Download Pack is available.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: The export / download pack is internal artifact generation. It is not bankability.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The What Changed delta indicator shows a compact comparison of 10 KPIs across runs.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: The What Changed deltas are explanatory indicators, not guaranteed accuracy claims. The exploratory banner is required for Generic Solar / Generic Wind.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The exploratory banner is required for Generic Solar / Generic Wind deltas.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: The exploratory banner makes it clear that the deltas are not Excel-parity validated.
